category_context: title/main-event wrappers normalized with pre-existing literal_map; no historical rates encoded
fit_rows: current inner/outer finish-only training history; never score/evaluation rows
numeric: float64; null stays null until fitted imputation; inf or nonnumeric is a hard failure
pairs: pooled finite values from both columns; numpy median; fail closed if all missing; no zero fallback
scaling: StandardScaler(with_mean=True,with_std=True) on transformed training numeric features only, population variance ddof=0; zero-variance scale=1; title and one-hot unscaled
scheduled_rounds: training numeric median; fail closed if all missing
source_semantics: do not re-estimate governed F02 career shrinkage; consume frozen PIT states; training-only refers to MOV1 imputation/encoding/scaling
title_bout: strict boolean 0/1, null training mode; ties False before True; fail all missing

weight_class.encoding: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore,drop=None,sparse_output=False,dtype=float64), categories learned in lexical order on training only
weight_class.mode: training normalized class mode; lexical tie break; fail all missing
weight_class.normalization: use existing literal_map before training-mode imputation; retain raw label for immutable terrain; unknown nonnull raw label fails
weight_class.unseen_known_division: all-zero one-hot vector; report N; no future encoder/category fitting
